title: WHAT IF YOU COULD GROW AT WILL?

segments.line: Mum hid the cookies
on top of the fridge.
Grow.
Snack time.
Late for school?
Grow.
One giant step.
Your best friend is looking for you.
Grow.
Again.
Again.
Okay, that's terrifying.
What if you could grow, any time you wanted?
One word, and you get bigger.
As big as you like. Sounds amazing.
Pigeons think you're a building.
Your best friend gets the best seat in town.
And you're the coolest kid in the city.
But here's the catch.
Ten times taller means a thousand times heavier.
Your bones? Only a hundred times stronger.
So every square inch of bone carries ten times the load.
And a human thigh bone breaks at about ten times your body weight.
Your very first step? Snap.
That's real.
You sit down on a rooftop and wait to shrink back.
The next morning, a man in a suit is waiting in your kitchen.
He has a photo of you. And an offer.
Then the ceiling starts to crack.
Upstairs, your little sister just said the word.
Do you run up and save her… or do you keep your secret?

shots.line: Mum hid the cookies
shots.note: Pip devant le frigo, la tête levée vers le bocal à cookies posé tout en haut

shots.line: on top of the fridge.
shots.note: le bocal en haut du frigo ; la moufle de Pip s'étire et reste trop courte

shots.line: Grow.
shots.note: GRANDIS : Pip grandit d'un coup, la tête frôle la suspension qui se balance

shots.line: Snack time.
shots.note: Pip géant, courbé sous le plafond, croque un cookie, satisfait

shots.line: Late for school?
shots.note: Pip sur le palier, l'horloge marque 8 h, panique

shots.line: Grow.
shots.note: GRANDIS : Pip grandit sur le palier, la lanterne vacille

shots.line: One giant step.
shots.note: une seule enjambée : son pied géant atterrit en bas de l'escalier, les cadres sautent

shots.line: Your best friend is looking for you.
shots.note: Mo sur le toit au crépuscule, la main en visière, cherche son ami

shots.line: Grow.
shots.note: GRANDIS : derrière le parapet, une capuche géante monte au-dessus des immeubles

shots.line: Again.
shots.note: ENCORE : le visage géant de Pip au-dessus de la ville, aussi grand que le soleil

shots.line: Again.
shots.note: ENCORE : Pip dépasse les immeubles, la tête dans les nuages ; Mo minuscule sur le toit

shots.line: Okay, that's terrifying.
shots.note: Mo se retourne, terrifié ; derrière lui, flou, l'œil géant de Pip

shots.line: What if you could grow, any time you wanted?
shots.note: le titre sur la ville au crépuscule ; Pip géant entre les immeubles, le soleil derrière l'épaule

shots.line: One word, and you get bigger.
shots.note: One word: Pip grows by his desk, his hood up against the ceiling

shots.line: As big as you like. Sounds amazing.
shots.note: the colossus over the rooftops, arms wide, clouds and pigeons round his head

shots.line: Pigeons think you're a building.
shots.note: pigeons perched on his hood; one more lands

shots.line: Your best friend gets the best seat in town.
shots.note: Mo sits in Pip's huge open palm, waving, high over the city

shots.line: And you're the coolest kid in the city.
shots.note: Pip géant lève les bras, des oiseaux tournent autour de sa tête, un avion passe

shots.line: But here's the catch.
shots.note: le sourire de Pip tombe ; un craquement

shots.line: Ten times taller means a thousand times heavier.
shots.note: ×10 de hauteur → un cube devient 1 000 cubes : POIDS ×1000

shots.line: Your bones? Only a hundred times stronger.
shots.note: la section de l'os ×100 ; charge par cm² ×10, au seuil de rupture du fémur

shots.line: So every square inch of bone carries ten times the load.
shots.note: one square inch of bone: ×1 then ×10 the load (weight ×1,000 over bone ×100)

shots.line: And a human thigh bone breaks at about ten times your body weight.
shots.note: the thigh bone; the load climbs to the breaking line at about ×10 body weight; it cracks

shots.line: Your very first step? Snap.
shots.note: Pip géant lève un pied pour enjamber un immeuble : CRAC, flash rouge

shots.line: That's real.
shots.note: Pip assis sur un immeuble, la jambe tenue, le ciel vire au rouge

shots.line: You sit down on a rooftop and wait to shrink back.
shots.note: he sits on the roof and shrinks back slowly as night falls

shots.line: The next morning, a man in a suit is waiting in your kitchen.
shots.note: le lendemain : Pip entre en béquille, plâtre à la jambe ; l'homme en costume l'attend près de l'îlot

shots.line: He has a photo of you. And an offer.
shots.note: l'homme en costume pose la photo du géant sur l'îlot ; maman, inquiète, derrière

shots.line: Then the ceiling starts to crack.
shots.note: la suspension se met à osciller, une fissure court au plafond, de la poussière tombe

shots.line: Upstairs, your little sister just said the word.
shots.note: la petite sœur, les yeux qui s'allument en or, un sourire espiègle ; la pièce tremble

shots.line: Do you run up and save her… or do you keep your secret?
shots.note: Pip lève les yeux vers le plafond qui se fissure, puis regarde l'homme en costume (flou au premier plan)
PART 1 / WHAT WOULD YOU DO?
